title: Entropy Coding Duel
tagline: Compares compression cost growth across four entropy coding strategies under increasing symbol alphabet size.

curves.label: Adaptive Huffman
curves.code: for(sym of stream){ updateFrequencies(); rebalanceOrRebuildTreeIfNeeded(); emitCode(sym); }
curves.name: Adaptive Huffman

curves.label: Range Coder
curves.code: for(sym of stream){ updateLowHigh(range, cumFreq, total); renormalize(); }
curves.name: Range Coder

curves.label: Arithmetic Coding
curves.code: for(sym of stream){ narrowInterval(cumFreq,total); while(renormalizeCondition) renormalize(); outputBitsWhenReady(); }
curves.name: Arithmetic Coding

curves.label: rANS (tANS stack)
curves.code: initStates(); for(sym of stream reverse){ state = xfer(state, cumFreq, total); } flushAndConvertToBits();
curves.name: rANS (tANS stack)
